title: Petra and the Wreck
author: Quentin Sandoval
blurb: Ulyana Halloran, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
